name: Checklist of steps finishing one by one
description: A white app card on the clean background: an app name and an 'INPUT' chip with a file name at the top, then a list of steps, each with a spinning orange ring; the rings turn into orange check marks one after another, the finished step text goes dark while pending ones stay grey, and a thin orange bar along the bottom fills up.
use_when: A tool or process doing several things for you: 'it transcribes, finds B-roll and edits the video', 'upload, and it handles the rest', a pipeline, an onboarding, or any 'first this, then this' automation.

title.help: app or tool name in the card header, e.g. 'NORTHWIND'

chip.help: file name shown in the 'INPUT' chip, e.g. 'raw_take.mov'; empty = no chip

steps.help: step labels in order (strings), 3-4 read best; keep each under ~26 characters
